text: O que é Agentforce?

Agentforce é a plataforma de agentes autônomos de IA da Salesforce, criada para automatizar decisões e ações em ambientes críticos como o setor de Óleo & Gás.

Como funciona:

Gatilho — Um evento inicia o agente (mudança de dado, horário, input externo).
Raciocínio — O agente aplica regras de negócio e IA para decidir o que fazer.
Ação — O agente executa tarefas (cria registros, envia alertas, aprova, escala).
Guardrails — Limites definidos pelo negócio (ex: nunca aprovar acima de X, sempre escalar Y).

Princípios-chave:

Sempre dentro dos limites do negócio.
Escalona para humanos em exceções.
Gera trilha de auditoria completa de cada decisão.
Usa dados reais do CRM, sem “alucinação”.
Opera 24/7, ideal para ambientes offshore, logística e trading.

No Óleo & Gás:

Agentes de precificação reagem a movimentos de mercado em minutos.
Agentes offshore atuam quando equipes estão fora de turno.
Agentes de compliance monitoram mudanças regulatórias (ANP, IBAMA, ANTT).
Agentes logísticos antecipam problemas antes de impactar clientes.

A arquitetura usa o Atlas Reasoning Engine, que processa gatilhos, aplica guardrails e executa ações, sempre com possibilidade de escalonamento.

Quer exemplos práticos de uso no seu segmento?

text: what is pre salt

Pre-salt refers to a set of giant oil and gas reserves located deep offshore Brazil, beneath a thick layer of salt rock (“pré-sal” in Portuguese). These reservoirs are found under 2,000 meters of water and up to 7,000 meters below the seabed, making them technically challenging to access.

Key points about pre-salt:

Most of Brazil’s offshore production now comes from pre-salt fields, especially in the Santos and Campos Basins.
Pre-salt fields deliver some of the highest productivity wells in the world, with single wells often exceeding 30,000 barrels per day.
The salt layer acts as a seal, trapping large volumes of high-quality, low-sulfur oil.
Pre-salt development accelerated after 2010, driving Brazil’s rise as a top-10 global oil producer.
Petrobras and its partners operate most pre-salt platforms, but international companies are increasing their presence.

Salesforce relevance: Pre-salt operations generate huge data volumes (IoT sensors, well integrity, HSE events) and require advanced automation for compliance, crew rotation, maintenance, and partner management. Solutions like Service Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce support real-time monitoring, incident response, and regulatory reporting—crucial for maximizing uptime and safety in these high-value assets.

text: explain me downstream brasilian mkt share

In Brazil’s downstream fuel distribution market, the top five companies dominate market share:

Vibra (formerly BR Distribuidora)
Ipiranga
Raízen (Shell licensee)
Alesat
Taurus

Key facts:

Over 42,000 gas stations operate nationwide.
The market value exceeds R$700 billion annually.
Logistics represents 8-12% of total fuel costs, with 65% of fuel moved by tanker trucks.

Market share is highly concentrated—Vibra, Ipiranga, and Raízen together control most of the market, with the remaining share split among smaller players like Alesat and Taurus. These companies compete on pricing, delivery reliability, dealer experience, and commercial agility.

How Salesforce helps:

Revenue Cloud and Agentforce automate pricing and margin controls, reacting in minutes to Petrobras price changes or FX moves.
Data Cloud and Field Service optimize delivery, predict stockouts, and prioritize high-value accounts.
Tableau and MuleSoft provide real-time margin dashboards and integrate with Petrobras pricing and logistics systems.

text: Well Integrity Agent

The Well Integrity Agent is an autonomous Salesforce-powered agent designed specifically for upstream oil and gas operations, including Brazil’s pre-salt offshore platforms. Its core function is to monitor well integrity in real time by ingesting pressure, temperature, and flow data from IoT sensors and SCADA systems.

Key capabilities:

Detects anomalies in well pressure, temperature, and other integrity metrics.
Classifies the severity of any detected anomaly (e.g., minor fluctuation, critical failure risk).
Automatically creates and routes work orders in Service Cloud for immediate investigation or remediation.
Integrates with Field Service to dispatch qualified maintenance crews, ensuring compliance with regulatory (ANP) and operator standards.
Maintains a full audit trail of all actions and decisions for regulatory reporting and internal review.

Business impact:

Reduces unplanned downtime and environmental risk by enabling proactive well management.
Ensures compliance with ANP well integrity regulations and operator best practices.
Improves offshore crew safety and operational efficiency.

Salesforce differentiators:

Real-time data ingestion and analytics via Data Cloud.
Automated workflows and escalation through Agentforce.
Seamless integration with maintenance and HSE systems (MuleSoft, Service Cloud).
